name: Steve Kelly
bio: Steve Kelly founded Maine Dispensary Guide in 2021 after four years operating a medical caregiver practice in southern Maine. He holds a Maine Cannabis Cultivation Registration and spent 2020-2022 collaborating with the Office of Cannabis Policy on caregiver-to-licensee transition documentation. His founder-level focus: regulatory mapping, the municipal opt-in landscape, and making complex Title 28-B mechanics legible to first-time operators.

Author of record on founder-story and editorial-policy pages
Editorial signatory on YMYL operator-facing guide revisions
Publisher of record for the Maine Opt-In Tracker and Regulatory Maps
knowsAbout: Municipal opt-in landscape across all 500+ Maine towns
Operator strategy and licensing timeline planning
description: Steve Kelly is the founder and publisher of Maine Dispensary Guide, the role under which he signs editorial direction and is accountable for the site's content. His writing for the site focuses on Maine regulatory history, the caregiver-to-licensee transition, and the municipal opt-in landscape across Maine's 500+ towns. This is the publisher's editorial position rather than a third-party attestation of independent expertise.
